summary: Implemented and independently verified the bounded F74 Sales Records backend: closed changed-only tri-state records, immutable event and return-edit receipt storage, exact count/detail provenance, creation identity snapshots, settlement, bulk sale, bulk return, direct status, direct customer, anonymous-customer, and import integrity paths. The coverage ledger explicitly leaves return creation and wide contact/payment reference cascades unfinished.
changes: Defined a closed Sales Records API with known_value, known_none, and unknown states; historical labels come from immutable snapshots and raw audit variables never reach the UI contract.
Added append-only sale_record_events and return_mutation_receipts with bounded validation, provenance uniqueness, backup/reset lifecycle coverage, and ordinary-pruning exclusion.

Captured exact changed-only records for creation, delivery and item amendments, settlement, sale bulk status/update including Undo/Redo, return bulk parent status, direct status/cancel/uncancel, and guarded direct return edits.
Captured direct customer identity and membership changes while preserving marked anonymous historical IDs, rejecting anonymous targets, and avoiding phone/address value retention.
Made historical import customer matching order-independent and fail-closed for invalid, ambiguous, stale, or concurrently duplicated phone/name evidence.
Recorded the unimplemented return-create and wide contact/payment cascade designs and dependencies in durable contract, plan, and coverage artifacts.

risks: The recursive canonical-phone SQL guard is deliberately fail-closed but has a residual performance cost on large customer tables.
Direct status and return edit server requirements need the paired frontend stable-request lifecycle in the same release; backend commits alone are not a release candidate.
Migration 0141 and paired frontend anonymous masking commit 7ba9aa72 are required before the integrated anonymous behavior can ship.
The customer_contact_changed metadata extension is contract-only and must not be advertised until backend schema/writers and EN/KM rendering are implemented and reviewed.
The revised wide-writer architecture at eea88ad0 remains a plan-only rereview candidate; it authorizes no migration or runtime writer change.
blockers: Full F74 coverage is blocked on an atomic return-create batch with a stable create receipt and paired frontend request lifecycle.
Full F74 coverage is blocked on independently approved, receipt-backed constant-statement event hooks for customer carry/merge/relink/resolve-missing and linked payment-name cascades.
not_done: Return creation does not yet append a typed parent sale-status event; the unsafe first implementation was reverted after a proven concurrent-create race.
Customer profile carry, customer/delivery merge, relink, resolve-missing, and linked payment-method rename do not yet append immutable per-sale events.
The contract-only customer_contact_changed kind and changed_contact_fields metadata are not present in the current event schema or reader.
No deployment, remote migration, production D1 command, anonymous marker repair, or other production write was performed.
